claim_boundary: This is a component inventory and evidence map. Static checks, electrical simulation/model proxies, host/firmware fixtures, and physical qualification are separate classes; coverage here does not claim comprehensive actual-hardware simulation.

tactile.boundary: Inherited V3 signal-chain and mux decks cover the reviewed topology and proxy loading. V4 differential ADC settling has five completed native cases. V4 rail coupling and physical sensor/cable behavior remain open.

power.status: static_and_partial_native_run; finite-impedance and physical qualification pending
power.boundary: Power arithmetic and selected buck execution are evidenced. The finite-impedance rail qualification and thermal/physical behavior are open.

camera.boundary: Interface arithmetic and framed browser fixture are covered; no camera capture or SI proof is claimed.

imu.boundary: Register/interface checks and native raw/status framing are covered; sensor output and mechanical placement remain physical work.

sd.status: interface/source evidence; storage hardware qualification pending
sd.boundary: Pin, footprint, and source evidence are recorded; card insertion, signal integrity, filesystem endurance, and thermal behavior remain physical work.

requested_size.detail: Current assembly 112 × 105.6 × 47.1 mm and estimated 218.2–233.2 g before textile/harness exceed the preferred 50.8 × 38.1 mm footprint. A compact redesign or explicitly accepted dimensioned alternative is required; CAD clearance alone does not close this requirement.

landed_cost_and_delivery.detail: The requested $150–200 complete one-glove budget is unclosed. Exact assembled/printed/harness/sensor/battery cost, minimum quantities, shipping, VAT and delivery dates need a complete current quote; partial component subtotals do not satisfy it.

continuous_runtime.detail: The conservative 6.019 h calculation leaves about 1.16 minutes over the six-hour target. Changes to electronics/thermal design must update the budget. Delivery requires six-hour simultaneous camera/tactile/IMU/storage operation with recorded temperature, current, capacity and drop counters.

physical_and_demo_acceptance.detail: First-article signal/calibration, camera, IMU, storage, radio, harness and wearable-fit checks remain unmeasured. The current reference hand mesh/contact display does not establish finger joint angles, precise hidden-hand position or calibrated roughness; the requested tracking/texture demo needs its own measured acceptance evidence.

routing_open_items.detail: 20 unconnected items remain; the routing candidate DRC includes USB-net/pair work in the blocker scope.

mechanical_revision.detail: Clearance evidence matches current component placement.

coupled_analog.detail: One complete conditioned63-amplifier native diagnostic; isolated tightening of gmin or abstol fails, so numerical qualification remains open.

rail_finite_impedance.detail: A corrected native buck run is recorded; full finite-impedance rail qualification remains open.

usb_high_current_path.detail: The unapplied20-open candidate improves USB inlet routing. Its actual U32 OUT and U42 VBUS surface escapes still need width/thermal correction; plane-only resistance was insufficient evidence. Canonical board remains24-open.

shutdown_fault_paths.detail: Lost-source latch, bounded camera queue and owner-acknowledged checked shutdown are built/tested. Permanent peripheral/control-bus faults still need independent reset/power-off hardware; current firmware holds shutdown rather than asserting successful sleep.

thermal.detail: Thermal-resistance sensitivity calculations exceed contact/pack screening targets; the buffered temperature-readout and outward heat-path proposals have local evidence plus a native-tested isolated temperature policy; circuit and shutdown integration remain unapplied and continuous wear remains unqualified.
